project.name: embabel-smith-tools
project.description: Aggregator for the tool addons: separately-built libraries that publish Embabel tool groups under named roles, which a deployment turns on by property. An addon here depends on neither the runtime, the studio nor the builder, so one can be added to or removed from a deployment without host code — the ban on poc-* artifacts that embabel-smith-prod declares is inherited by every submodule here.
